title: A study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs. Part 1: Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs $C_n(R)$ w.r.t. $m$ = 2
summary: This study is the first part of a detailed study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs having ten parts \cite{v2-1}-\cite{v2-10}. Circulant graphs $C_n(R)$ and $C_n(S)$ are said to be \emph{Adam's isomorphic} if there exist some $a\in \mathbb{Z}_n^*$ such that $S = a R$ under arithmetic reflexive modulo $n$ \cite{ad67}. In this paper, the author modified his earlier definition \cite{v96} of Type-2 isomorphism w.r.t. $m$ such that $m$ and $m^3$ are divisors of $\gcd(n, r)$ and $n$, respectively, and $r\in R$.
